questions.q: Explain why mammals need both a gas exchange surface and a circulatory system. Write in the portal response box.
questions.a: Large multicellular so small SA:V (1); diffusion distance to inner cells too long (1); lungs give large surface for gas exchange (1); blood carries oxygen and glucose to all cells and removes CO₂ (1)
questions.model: Teacher writes the first point: 'Mammals are large, so they have a small surface area to volume ratio.'

questions.q: Agar cube practical data: 1 cm cube coloured through in 4 min, 2 cm cube in 15 min. Explain.
questions.a: Larger cube has smaller SA:V (1) and longer distance to centre, so diffusion takes longer (1)

questions.q: Why do elephants have large thin ears in hot climates?
questions.a: Large SA for losing heat by radiation; thin with many blood vessels near the surface.

questions.q: Calculate SA:V for a 2 cm cube.
Explain why a flatworm does not need a circulatory system.
questions.a: It is very thin/flat so has a large SA:V (1); all cells are close to the surface, so diffusion is fast enough (1)

questions.q: Give two exchange surfaces in humans.
